reason: B is the better proposal because it specifies an executable single compositional intervention, a defined concentration range, a direct baseline, measurable retention and mechanical criteria, and a clear falsification experiment. Its Cu-segregation mechanism and cited support are only weakly transferable from FCC high-entropy alloys to MnNiSi, but A is less testable because it leaves the segregating elements unspecified and conflates grain-boundary segregation with optional twin-boundary promotion.
